```text

  ├─> index and registry inclusion rules

  └─> active-instrument navigation integrity

Metadata and authority contract
  ├─> valid instrument lifecycle states

  └─> all subsequent instrument amendments

  ├─> identity and continuity clarification
  ├─> agentic lifecycle architecture

Identity evidentiary repair

  ├─> agentic lifecycle duties
```

## Blocking dependencies

| Repair | Blocked by | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Corpus-wide metadata correction | Metadata and authority contract | Values cannot be reconciled until the controlled model is fixed |
| Security procedure relocation | Canonical definitions and source-authority rules | Otherwise the same doctrine will be duplicated again |
| Relational code migration | Replacement dimensional model | Simple word substitution would preserve the defective scale |
| Identity threshold repair | Definition and evidence rules | Threshold language must distinguish classification from validated measurement |
| Agentic lifecycle chartering | Controlled actor model | Duties cannot be assigned to undefined or overlapping actors |
| AI-BOM implementation | System-boundary definitions and actor model | Components and accountable owners must be controlled first |
| CAM conformance profile | AI-BOM and mandatory runtime evidence | Conformance cannot be demonstrated without an evidence package |

## Generated-output dependencies

Moving a file does not complete the structural repair by itself. The following outputs and tools must be regenerated or amended:

- Charter and Constitution indexes;
- global governance index and JSON registry;
- canonical-code index;
- terminology audit/index;
- schedule-generated registry projections;
- validators that recursively inspect `Governance/**`;
- public-interface consumers relying on old paths or identifiers.

`Governance/Drafts/**` must be excluded from operative outputs by default. A separate draft listing may be generated, but it must not be merged into current authoritative registries.

## External-work dependency boundary

The digital-species research paper, philosophical entity thresholds and unrelated research threads are not dependencies of this programme. Caelestis repair should use current standards and industry practice to test governance defensibility, not import unrelated paper-development questions into the corpus.
